title: A New GAUSS Software Component for Implementing Dynamic Tests of Contagion with an Application
abstract: arXiv:2610.41740v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The main goal of this article is to present a new software component created by the authors in GAUSS for implementing dynamic tests for contagion. These tests are aimed at providing the possibilities of testing for spiller-over effects between financial markets during a crisis or during a pandemic situation such as the one that we experienced recently. Unlike standard tests for contagion that have fixed dates for a potential shift, the tests implemented here are dynamic in the sense that the potential contagion effect is measured across the time span. The leverage bootstrap simulation technique is utilized in order to generate critical values that are reliable when the tests are implemented in order to make sure that the conducted inference is accurate. translated_title: 一个用于实施传染动态检验的新型GAUSS软件组件及其应用
translated_abstract: 本文的主要目标是介绍作者开发的一个新的GAUSS软件组件，用于实施传染的动态检验。这些检验旨在提供检验金融危机期间或大流行疫情期间（如我们最近经历的那种情况）金融市场之间溢出效应的可能性。与具有固定潜在变化日期的标准传染检验不同，本文实施的检验是动态的，即在整个时间段内测量潜在的传染效应。为了在实施检验时生成可靠的临界值，采用了杠杆自助法模拟技术，以确保所进行的推断是准确的。由于该方法较新，需要创建软件组件来进行相关检验，本文即完成了这一工作。该模块非常易于实现……
tldr: 本文开发了一个新的GAUSS软件组件，用于实施动态传染检验，能够在危机或大流行期间测量金融市场之间随时间变化的溢出效应，并采用杠杆自助法模拟技术生成可靠的临界值以确保推断的准确性。
